summary: @ornikar/repo-config-react preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` that runs automatically on `npm install`. `setup.mjs` is written with obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers (e.g. `_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) and wrapper objects hiding direct calls to `execFileSync`, `https.get`, `fs.chmodSync`, and `zlib.inflateRawSync`. It downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...zip`, extracts and chmod+x's the `bun` binary, then invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [.../math_init.js ])` to run a bundled 727KB sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` carries a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header and uses the canonical string-array-rotate scheme (large `n7gIxM=[...]` array plus a `WV8StW(a,e,j)` shift decoder) with randomized short identifiers, so its runtime behavior is hidden from Node-based static inspection. Neither downloading Bun nor executing a large obfuscated blob is consistent with the advertised purpose of a React repo-config package; routing execution through Bun specifically evades Node-oriented analysis of the payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
